title: Rset (staff)
body:
Syntax: rset create <vnum>  |  rset goto <vnum>  |  rset <subcommand> ...  (alias: redit)
rset always acts on the room you're physically standing in, right now -- no separate, stale 'editing' state to track. 'create'/'goto' teleport you to the target room first, so every other subcommand naturally follows.

Description: Creates and edits rooms field by field.

&WCreation/navigation:&x
  create <vnum>              -- makes a new, blank room, teleports you into it, and starts editing it
  goto <vnum>                -- teleports you to an existing room to edit it (same as the standalone 'goto' command)
  show                       -- same as 'rstat' on the room you're standing in

&WBasic fields:&x
  name [text]                -- room name; no text opens a line editor
  desc [text]                -- room description; no text opens a full editor
  sector <type>              -- terrain/sector label (mostly cosmetic)
  biome <type>               -- tags the room for elemental jutsu affinity and gathering-job placement
  resetmsg [text|off]        -- room-specific atmospheric flavor line, shown every 15 minutes on the fixed area reset timer -- overrides the containing area's own message (see 'help area') if both are set; 'off' clears it

&WExits:&x
  exit <direction> <vnum>    -- one-way exit only
  bexit <direction> <vnum>   -- two-way exit (this room <-> that room, both directions linked); an unrecognized vnum is created automatically as a blank room
  bunlink <direction>        -- removes an exit and its reverse
  exitflag <direction> <flag> [value] -- door/locked/hidden/keyitem/passcode on a specific exit

&WFlags and special states:&x
  safe on|off                -- PvP-safe zone toggle (blocks attacking other players here)
  apartment on|off           -- marks this room as a purchasable apartment shell (see 'help apartment')
  flags <flagname>           -- toggles a recognized room flag on/off (CapturePoint, accelerated_healing) -- see 'help flags'

&WRoom programs:&x
  addprogram <trigger> <action> <args...>
  removeprogram <index>      -- index shown by 'rstat'

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-08-21
